```{julia}
const DIR_PRJ = string(strip(read(`git rev-parse --show-toplevel`, String)))
using Pkg
Pkg.activate(DIR_PRJ)
```

```{julia}
using CSV, DataFrames, TidierData
```

# PIM

```{julia}
DEPRECIATION_RATE = 1 / 3
```

```{julia}
flow = CSV.read(
    joinpath(DIR_PRJ, "data", "flow.tsv"),
    DataFrame
)
```

```{julia}
function pim(tbl)
    netstock = zeros(size(tbl.volume))
    cfc = zeros(size(tbl.volume))
    netstock[1] = tbl.volume[1] / DEPRECIATION_RATE
    for i in 2:length(netstock)
        netstock[i] = tbl.volume[i] / 2 +
            (netstock[i - 1] + tbl.volume[i] / 2) *
            (1 - DEPRECIATION_RATE)
        cfc[i] = (tbl.volume[i] / 2 + netstock[i - 1]) * DEPRECIATION_RATE
    end
    tbl[!, :netstock] = netstock
    tbl[!, :cfc] = cfc
    tbl
end
```

```{julia}
prices = @chain CSV.read(
    joinpath(DIR_PRJ, "data", "prices.tsv"),
    DataFrame
    ) begin
    @select(year, price = price / 100)
end
```

```{julia}
netstock = @chain flow begin
    @arrange(account, year)
    @select(account, year, volume)
    dropmissing!
    @group_by(account)
    combine(pim)
    @inner_join(prices)
    @mutate(
        cfc = cfc * price,
        netstock,
        current_cost_netstock = netstock * price
    )
    dropmissing!
    @select(-price)
end
```

```{julia}
CSV.write(
    joinpath(DIR_PRJ, "data", "stock.tsv"),
    netstock,
    delim = '\t'
)
```
